node.statement: For every A,B in calU, X=A^dagger has right inverse A. If R=L_A^{-1}(J), then ||R||<=3 and the associator comparison of A^dagger bold-dot(A bold-dot R) with (A^dagger bold-dot A) bold-dot R gives ||A^dagger-R||<=12e; thus ||A bold-dot A^dagger-J||<25e. Therefore ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<25e. For X=A bold-dot B, put M=L_A composed with L_B. The preceding bound gives ||M^{-1}||<9, while ||L_X-M||<=e||A||||B||<=4e. Thus ||M^{-1}(L_X-M)||<36e<=9/16, so the Neumann series makes L_X invertible and X has a right inverse. Also (A bold-dot B)^dagger=B^dagger bold-dot A^dagger; one outer associator costs at most 20e, the inner comparison A^dagger bold-dot(A bold-dot B) versus (A^dagger bold-dot A) bold-dot B costs at most 8e and, after left multiplication by B^dagger, less than 17e. Hence ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<37e<40e.
